_comment_header: === TEST: FIXED PRESSURE OUTLET BOUNDARY CONDITIONS ===
_comment_purpose: Test fixed pressure outlet BCs (simplest BC type)
_expected: ~2.5M cells, 30-45 min runtime, all outlets at same pressure

case_info.description: TEST: Fixed pressure outlet BC validation
case_info.notes: Testing fixed pressure BCs - expect all outlets at 80 mmHg

mesh._comment_resolution: Coarse mesh for quick BC test

outlets._test_focus: Simplest BC type - all outlets at same pressure
outlets._expected_behavior: All 4 outlets will have identical pressure
outlets._flow_distribution: Flow split determined purely by outlet geometry (area, resistance)
outlets._note: This is the SIMPLEST outlet BC - useful for validation and quick tests

_test_checklist.1_bc_files: Verify 0/p file has fixedValue 10666 Pa for all outlets
_test_checklist.2_equal_pressures: All outlets should have IDENTICAL pressure (80 mmHg = 10666 Pa)
_test_checklist.3_flow_conservation: Sum of outlet flows should equal inlet flow (within 0.5%)
_test_checklist.4_geometry_based_split: Flow distribution based on outlet areas/geometry
_test_checklist.5_no_windkessel_files: Should NOT create Windkessel parameter files
_test_checklist.6_no_resistance_files: Should NOT have outlet-specific resistance settings
_test_checklist.7_simple_setup: Simplest BC configuration - easy to verify
_test_checklist.8_stable_convergence: Very stable (fixed pressure is most robust BC)

_expected_behavior.flow_split: Determined by geometry - larger outlets get more flow
_expected_behavior.stability: Should converge very easily (most stable BC type)
_expected_behavior.realistic: Not physiologically realistic (no compliance), but good for validation

_validation_commands.verify_pressure: All outlets should have identical pressure values

_advantages_for_testing.1_simple: Easiest BC to understand and verify

_limitations.not_realistic: Doesn't capture arterial compliance (use Windkessel for that)

_expected_runtime: 30-45 minutes (mesh: 10 min, solver: 20-35 min on 4 cores, fastest BC type)
